title: Green Spinach and Blueberry Smoothie
excerpt: A creamy, flavorful green shake that combines the freshness of spinach with the natural sweetness of our high-mountain blueberries. Perfect to renew your mornings.
imageAlt: Crystal glass with a bright green smoothie decorated with whole fresh blueberries and spinach leaves on a wooden table.

ingredients.text: 1 cup coconut water or almond milk

steps: Place the coconut water, spinach leaves and the teaspoon of lemon juice in the blender.
Blend on high speed for 30 seconds until the spinach breaks down completely and the liquid is evenly green.
Add the Fresh Pick blueberries, patiently grown in the mountains of Guasca, along with the chia seeds and the ice.
Blend everything for 45 more seconds until you get a smooth, even, creamy mixture.
Serve immediately in two cold glasses and enjoy right away.
tips: If you like a frappé-style texture, freeze the Fresh Pick blueberries about 30 minutes before making your smoothie.
To keep the freshness and natural bloom of your blueberries at home, store them in the refrigerator in a container with paper towel, unwashed, until you are ready to use them.
